ios.desc:
When was the last time you swapped your toothbrush? Changed your sheets? Descaled the coffee machine?
hōki remembers low-frequency chores and tells you what’s actually due.

# Why hōki

• Do tasks when needed, not by arbitrary dates.

• Enjoy a minimalist, lightweight design.

• No account needed: tasks are stored on your phone.

• iCloud backups & syncing of your tasks


I built it for myself to reduce mental load. You’ll never ask “when did I last do X?” again.


# Perfect for

Home maintenance, filter changes, plant care, pet treatments, deep-cleaning, seasonal checkups or any recurring task.

quotes.text:
Hello HN,

When was the last time you swapped your toothbrush? What about your sheets?

Life is full of these mundane tasks that have to be done at semi-regular intervals, but where the exact timing doesn't matter too much.

I used to track these tasks with the built-in reminders app, but it wasn't a good match: the tasks only have two states, and the intervals are computed based on the due date rather than the completion date.

It just didn't feel like the right tool for the job.

I created hōki in my spare time to scratch my own itch, so to say, and I have been using it daily.

Maybe you'll find it useful as well.

It certainly has helped me wean off the all or nothing mentality that I had when doing chores.
